rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Certified Correct
card.instruction: Treat forms, standards, and exact wording as a technical craft. Correct shortcuts before discussing whether the result actually works.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before we sign off your evacuation plan, these arrows need the approved red.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone found the exit during the drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. We'll discuss that after the arrows match the sample.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sample faded in the window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need a replacement sample before we can establish what everyone successfully followed.

card.title: Certified Correct
card.instruction: Treat forms, standards, and exact wording as a technical craft. Correct shortcuts before discussing whether the result actually works.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This cake cannot pass inspection. You've written 'Birthday Happy.'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The icing slid. Does it taste all right?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Taste is in section four. We're still on greeting accuracy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we turn the plate around?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That corrects the order while introducing an upside-down birthday.

card.title: Customs Interpreter
card.instruction: Act as the translator of unwritten customs. Correct breaches, explain exceptions, and make your usefulness proof that you belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At your family's dinners, that chair stays empty for your aunt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's abroad. Sit with us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only her grandchildren can borrow it. I learned that at Easter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then take mine. I'll fetch another.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yours faces the kitchen; whoever sits there explains the dishes. Yes, I know them all now.

card.title: Customs Interpreter
card.instruction: Act as the translator of unwritten customs. Correct breaches, explain exceptions, and make your usefulness proof that you belong.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At this club, 'interesting proposal' means withdraw it. I can help with the reply.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The chair said 'very interesting' and invited me to lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lunch is the exception. Keep the proposal; let them order first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Come along. You can explain the menu.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the seating. Tell the secretary I'm your adviser; guests have to leave before coffee.

card.title: I Learned It the Hard Way
card.instruction: Treat experience with the system as seniority. Teach its shortcuts, warn against its traps, and remind everyone that your mistakes came first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring a sandwich to the permit office. I lost three Tuesdays learning that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says appointments take ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how they get your first Tuesday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked the first slot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So did I. Eat half the sandwich before they open.

card.title: I Learned It the Hard Way
card.instruction: Treat experience with the system as seniority. Teach its shortcuts, warn against its traps, and remind everyone that your mistakes came first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't ask the committee why the roof leaks. Ask which meeting owns the leak.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I asked why. They made me chair of causes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've already asked me to investigate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for your predecessor's report. That's mine. It took six meetings to learn how to request a ladder.

card.title: The Necessary Signature
card.instruction: Remain helpful while controlling the one approval, record, key, or ceremonial step that allows anything to move forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your moving van can leave the depot as soon as I stamp the release.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Great. I've completed the request.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. I'll check it while you wait here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you check it in the cab? The driver's charging by the minute.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I'll bring the stamp so you won't have to drive back for permission to leave.

card.title: The Necessary Signature
card.instruction: Remain helpful while controlling the one approval, record, key, or ceremonial step that allows anything to move forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Everyone's ready for your club opening. I've brought the ribbon scissors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Wonderful. Hand them to the mayor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll guide her hand. These are the ceremonial ones.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She cuts ribbons every week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. She'll understand why I keep the safety catch until the photographer nods.

card.title: We Know the Old Rules
card.instruction: Use an old custom you learned together as the deepest proof of connection, even when the present situation has changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before dinner, we still split the first bread roll. Like when we shared a room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can afford two rolls now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll each have half of two.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's mathematically a whole roll.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, but you can't buy the sharing separately.

card.title: We Know the Old Rules
card.instruction: Use an old custom you learned together as the deepest proof of connection, even when the present situation has changed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You haven't given me our old knock before coming in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You gave me a key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The key opens the door. The knock tells me it's you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can see me through the glass.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And yet I haven't heard from my best friend.

card.title: I Made the Exception
card.instruction: Treat every exception you once arranged as an unpaid obligation. Casually expect cooperation whenever the old favor becomes relevant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I got your late job application accepted. You can take my Saturday shift.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was two years ago.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you've had the job for all of them. Saturday seems modest.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It took you one phone call.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then make one to the manager. Tell her you're covering Saturday; we'll call that even.

card.title: I Made the Exception
card.instruction: Treat every exception you once arranged as an unpaid obligation. Casually expect cooperation whenever the old favor becomes relevant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Since I waived your joining fee, I'd like you to nominate me for treasurer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I paid you back the fee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You repaid money. I made you an exception.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's the exchange rate?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Currently, one enthusiastic nomination.

card.title: The Designated Translator
card.instruction: Return automatically to explaining rules, smoothing procedures, and answering questions before anyone asks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's your visitor badge. The blue lift skips reception; lunch vouchers are inside.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thanks. Where's the toilet?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Left of the lift. Take the badge; the door locks behind you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My colleague's holding it open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Give him this spare badge before you go in, or he'll need someone to hold it for him.

card.title: The Designated Translator
card.instruction: Return automatically to explaining rules, smoothing procedures, and answering questions before anyone asks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For Dad's dinner, bring bread even if he says not to. I'll explain the receipt business.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He texted me a shopping list.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. 'Bread' means the crusty loaf; sliced makes him think you're staying for breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's attached a photograph of the loaf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. I'll explain the acceptable substitutes before you reach the shop.

card.title: Better at the System
card.instruction: Treat every rule, shortcut, and correction as a chance to prove you understand the system better than anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My parking permit took six minutes at the expedited counter. Still filling yours in?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finished in five.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You must have found my counter. Did you mention the renewal exemption?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used the website. It applied that automatically.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you haven't learned where they hide the appeal button. I'll show you before you need it.

card.title: Better at the System
card.instruction: Treat every rule, shortcut, and correction as a chance to prove you understand the system better than anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You bowed twice at the awards dinner. The handbook specifies one bow.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The host bowed back, so I returned it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you accidentally acknowledged them as senior.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They are the host.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. I congratulated them without conceding rank.

card.title: My Sponsor Inside
card.instruction: Treat one person as your sponsor inside the system. Seek their introductions and approval while resisting the identity their support assigns you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you introduce me to the committee? Just not as your promising little discovery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How should I introduce you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As an independent professional whose work speaks for itself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you can introduce yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It speaks more clearly after you've said my name.

card.title: My Sponsor Inside
card.instruction: Treat one person as your sponsor inside the system. Seek their introductions and approval while resisting the identity their support assigns you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please get me into the club, but don't tell them you rescued me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm just signing your application.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A signature, not a creation story.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It asks how I know you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use the period after 'colleague' decisively.

card.title: The Rule You Broke
card.instruction: Treat a past breach of rule or custom as unfinished business. Let every present exception reopen the question of what was damaged.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're swapping your birthday-tea duty again? Last time you left me serving forty people alone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This time Maya agreed to cover.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put her name on the rota. Mine appeared after you'd gone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll write that you weren't responsible last time, too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Beside the complaint about the cold tea, please. That's where everyone learned I was unreliable.

card.title: The Rule You Broke
card.instruction: Treat a past breach of rule or custom as unfinished business. Let every present exception reopen the question of what was damaged.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're letting guests use the good mugs now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only because the other mugs are packed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When I used one, you called it a breach of trust.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You broke it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then explain why they're guests and I'm still a precedent.

transfer.action: I align {prop} with the official printed sample.
transfer.closing: Then reproducing it accurately should create very little difficulty.

transfer.action: I guide {prop} past the chair newcomers are supposed to use.
transfer.opening: Follow my greeting; I'll explain the custom afterward. {request}
transfer.response: That wasn't wrong, merely the visitor version. {counter}
transfer.challenge: Who knows all these unwritten rules?
transfer.closing: Someone who has spent years noticing which chairs make rooms awkward.

transfer.action: I put {prop} beside the rejected form that taught me the shortcut.
transfer.opening: This knowledge cost me three Tuesdays. {request}
transfer.response: Use the door I learned about the hard way. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then the shortcut would arrive without the respect its acquisition deserves.

transfer.action: I keep the release stamp poised over {prop}.
transfer.response: I'm happy to help once the request is complete. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then we can begin checking whether complete means the same to both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just say yes to the garden party and I'll release my booking stamp.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many guests?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's for after the stamp. The approval window is closing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're holding the window open.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Reward this convenient service with a quick yes.

bespokePairs.seedUse: A controls a necessary signature but pressures B for immediate approval of using it; the bottleneck becomes the reason not to examine consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nod now and I'll sign for the sofa delivery. Only I have the acceptance stamp.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will the sofa fit?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Measurement can follow the decisive nod.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you stamp it later?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the men holding the sofa will start asking your questions too.

bespokePairs.seedUse: A controls a necessary signature but pressures B for immediate approval of using it; the bottleneck becomes the reason not to examine consequences.

card.title: The Necessary Signature
card.instruction: Remain helpful while controlling the one approval, record, key, or ceremonial step that allows anything to move forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your moving van is ready. It just needs my departure stamp.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Wonderful. Could you stamp it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Have you completed the departure-stamp request?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're holding that too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I like to keep the process convenient for you.

card.title: Just Say Yes
card.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Quick yes to the garden party before the booking expires?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many guests?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's a lovely follow-up question for after yes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And the cost?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The hesitation is free, but we're running out of it.

card.title: The Necessary Signature
card.instruction: Remain helpful while controlling the one approval, record, key, or ceremonial step that allows anything to move forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The club has approved your opening ceremony. I'm holding the ribbon scissors.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then cut the ribbon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Once I receive confirmation that the ceremony has begun.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Cutting it begins the ceremony.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. I'll wait for the confirmation beside the ribbon.

card.title: Just Say Yes
card.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just nod and I'll accept the sofa delivery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will it fit through the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We can measure after securing the bargain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's already outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nod before they start measuring too.

transfer.action: I put {prop} in the old arrangement and use the full greeting.
transfer.opening: We learned it before they shortened it. {request}
transfer.response: Our old places still make sense to me. {counter}
transfer.closing: The words did. My hands still remember the version we shared.

transfer.action: I set your old exemption beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: I found you a way around the rule once. {request}
transfer.closing: No. This time I'm the person hoping an exception can be admirable.

transfer.action: I rewrite the dense notice beside {prop} in plain language.
transfer.response: Bring me the page where everybody gets stuck. {counter}
transfer.closing: Excellent. I'll be here when the form stops supporting that ambition.

transfer.action: I finish the paperwork for {prop} before the instructions end.
transfer.opening: That's how you skip two counters. {request}
transfer.response: My method needs one signature fewer. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then admiring my shorter queue should feel entirely comfortable.

transfer.action: I take the access badge beside {prop}, removing my sponsor's nickname.
transfer.opening: An introduction, not an identity, please. {request}
transfer.response: I'll take help without becoming your project. {counter}
transfer.closing: I will, in my own name rather than the one you've planned for me.

transfer.action: I put the old breach record beside the new request about {prop}.
transfer.opening: This was supposedly unforgivable last time. {request}
transfer.response: Explain the exception before asking me to admire it. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then name the difference the old hurt hasn't been able to find.
